source.author: Majid D. Beni
source.title: Kinds Without Structure Are Blind; Structure Without Kinds Is Empty: Remarks on the Methodology of Consciousness Science
source.journal: Journal for General Philosophy of Science

strongest_reply.point: Beni does not rely on PP--FEP formal unification alone. The proposal explicitly treats natural-kind reasoning and structural realism as complementary: structural form is paired with empirical criteria, clustered content, markers, mechanisms, and measurements.
strongest_reply.implication_for_dr: Empirical natural-kind constraints can in principle discharge DR if they bear specifically on why a PP--FEP-exposed invariant is relevant to kind identity rather than merely available within the framework.
strongest_reply.manuscript_response: M24 states that DR does not accuse Beni of lacking empirical constraints; it specifies what those constraints must accomplish when structural invariance is assigned individuative force.

shared_inferential_form.shared_step: an invariant exposed within a scientific representation is recruited as evidence for sameness
shared_inferential_form.non_identity_claim: The two domains are not assumed to share the same metaphysics.
